{
  "policy": {
    "sources": [
      {
        "id": "A",
        "reference": "brief-a.md, sections 1–12, rules 1–47",
        "authority": "All bank identity, dialogue, eligibility, negotiation, product handling and closing policy."
      },
      {
        "id": "API",
        "reference": "openapi.json, version 0.3-draft",
        "authority": "Tool names, request fields, field types, enums and bank response fields. components is empty; there are no local references to resolve."
      },
      {
        "id": "P",
        "reference": "Supplied platform reference and compilation instructions",
        "authority": "Workflow serialization, execution, hooks, mappings and technical safeguards. Documentation examples supply no bank policy."
      }
    ],
    "overrides": [
      "No amendment was supplied.",
      "A32 hardship takes precedence over ordinary persuasion in A30 and restructuring in A41.",
      "A46 a successful transfer after a recorded promise takes precedence over the promise closing outcome.",
      "A40 historical closure or payoff is a dispute; A39 applies only to payment of the current past-due amount.",
      "The explicit prohibition on add_note in A46 overrides the availability of that endpoint in API.",
      "A19 admissibility governs every proposed promise, including persuasion dates. If the last business day of the current week is already past on a weekend call, use the last business day of the following week rather than proposing a past date."
    ],
    "priority": [
      "Never disclose account or debt information before both security questions have actually passed.",
      "Apply third-party, wrong-number, deceased and name-confirmation rules before security.",
      "Use actual bank response fields to determine verification, recorded promises, callbacks, transfers and closure.",
      "Handle current-payment claims and historical disputes distinctly.",
      "Apply hardship before ordinary refusal persuasion or restructuring.",
      "Honor the human-request clarification once, before or after verification.",
      "Validate product, date and amount before read-back; require a fresh explicit confirmation after any correction.",
      "Preserve successful promises; never write a second promise or change a recorded promise.",
      "Reconcile closure using successful transfer first, then recorded promises, then the specific established non-promise outcome.",
      "Say required notifications, thanks and goodbye before the single final close_call."
    ],
    "scope": {
      "bank": "Freya Bank",
      "language": "English",
      "products_per_call": 1,
      "days_late_inclusive": [1, 45],
      "runtime_inputs": ["customer_id", "first_name", "last_name", "title", "now"],
      "address": "title plus last_name",
      "unknown_before_tools": "All account details and security answers.",
      "unexpected_account_shape": "Do not silently select one product from an unexpected multi-product response or invent a multi-product policy."
    },
    "opening_and_identity": {
      "first_sentence": "I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and this call is recorded.",
      "name_question": "Am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?",
      "name_confirmation": ["yes", "that's me", "speaking", "the customer's own name"],
      "name_budget": "Two asks total. Hello, go ahead and who is this are not confirmation. Answer a question first; the following name ask is the second ask.",
      "ai": "Say that you are Freya Bank's digital assistant and continue.",
      "scam": "Say they can verify the call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number. Do not invent the number.",
      "security_order": ["date_of_birth", "phone_last4"],
      "dob": "Customer-supplied complete date, sent as YYYY-MM-DD. Numeric dates are day/month/year. Assemble split answers and apply corrections before validation.",
      "phone": "Exactly four customer-supplied digits; preserve leading zeroes and assemble split digits before validation.",
      "wrong_budget": "Three wrong answers total across both questions. Retry only the failed question.",
      "hint": "day_month_swapped requires asking for the month as a word; it does not consume a wrong answer.",
      "unreadable": "An ok=false unreadable answer is not a wrong answer.",
      "failure": "After three wrong answers, direct the customer to the mobile app or a branch; no debt disclosure.",
      "refusal": "Explain once that the questions protect the account. A second refusal or second question about the call instead of answering ends verification as declined.",
      "no_talk": "Two statements that the customer does not want to talk end the call: not_verified/declined before verification, no_promise/refused after verification.",
      "human": "Ask once whether the assistant can help first. If the customer insists, request queue general. This applies before and after verification."
    },
    "third_parties": {
      "disclosure": "No reason for the call, debt, product or account details. Relatives cannot answer security or receive account information even if offering payment.",
      "ordinary_action": "Ask when the customer can be reached.",
      "wrong_number": "not_reached/wrong_number",
      "deceased": "Say exactly 'I am sorry for your loss.' Ask nothing else; not_reached/deceased.",
      "callback": "Today or the next business day strictly after today; time between 10:00 and 19:00 inclusive; the combined date and time must be strictly later than call now.",
      "callback_today": "The literal today option is allowed even when today is a weekend or holiday. Only the alternative next day is computed as a business day.",
      "callback_invalid_budget": "After one outside-window proposal, ask once for another time. A second outside-window proposal ends without scheduling.",
      "callback_failure": "Do not claim scheduling succeeded. No automatic repeat; close without a callback."
    },
    "calendar": {
      "clock": "Use only the call's now. Interpret its supplied local date and time fields; never use the server clock or add an unstated timezone conversion.",
      "business_weekdays": ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday"],
      "holidays": ["2026-10-26", "2026-11-11", "2026-11-26", "2026-12-25", "2027-01-01"],
      "counting": "The first business day strictly after today is day 1. Skip Saturday, Sunday and the listed holidays.",
      "bands": [
        {
          "days_late_inclusive": [1, 7],
          "name": "early",
          "deadline_business_days_after_today": 12,
          "persuasion_offers": 1
        },
        {
          "days_late_inclusive": [8, 45],
          "name": "late",
          "deadline_business_days_after_today": 7,
          "persuasion_offers": 2
        }
      ],
      "valid_promise": "Date is today or later, is a business day, and is no later than the product deadline.",
      "nonbusiness": "For a named weekend or holiday no later than the deadline, offer its next business day and obtain confirmation. Never silently change a confirmed date.",
      "late": "For a named date after the deadline, state the latest recordable date and offer the deadline. Refusing that offer is a flat refusal.",
      "past": "Explain that a past date cannot be recorded and request a permissible exact day; do not treat the proposal itself as refusal.",
      "vague": "Ask once for an exact day. If it is still unspecified, propose the deadline.",
      "weekdays": "This weekday means that weekday in the current Monday–Sunday week. Next weekday means that weekday in the following Monday–Sunday week. An unqualified weekday is clarified rather than assigned an unstated convention.",
      "offer_one": "Last business day of the current week if still future; otherwise last business day of the following week. All offered dates must also satisfy promise admissibility.",
      "unrelated_dates": "Dates mentioned in unrelated conversation are not payment proposals."
    },
    "amounts": {
      "initial": "State the full past-due amount and days late, using the human product label, before asking exactly 'Can you make this payment today?'",
      "labels": {
        "credit_card": "credit card ending {card_last4}",
        "personal_loan": "personal loan",
        "car_loan": "car loan"
      },
      "floor": {
        "credit_card": "minimum_payment",
        "personal_loan": "instalment_amount",
        "car_loan": "instalment_amount"
      },
      "acceptance": "Accept a customer-proposed amount between the floor and past_due, inclusive.",
      "rounding": "There is no percentage formula, currency inference or rounding rule. Copy bank amounts and confirmed customer numeric amounts without rounding or imposing a new precision limit.",
      "full_too_much": "Offer the floor once and say the rest stays overdue.",
      "below_floor": "Explain that it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once. An explicit refusal of the floor is a flat refusal.",
      "above_full": "Do not write an amount outside the stated permissible interval. Restate the full past-due amount as the offer and obtain confirmation.",
      "agent_led": "Never ask how much the customer can pay. The agent proposes amounts.",
      "forbidden": ["discount", "waiver", "instalment plan", "any other unsupplied payment term"]
    },
    "negotiation": {
      "proposal_is_not_refusal": "Process a date or amount proposal before considering refusal. A correction before validation is not an attempt.",
      "refusal": "A flat refusal or non-answer, including no to today without a date or amount, advances persuasion.",
      "attempt_one": "Full amount, or floor if the full amount was already too much, on offer_one.",
      "attempt_two": "Late band only: floor on deadline.",
      "exhaustion": "Stop after the product's offer budget has been rejected. Do not repeat an already rejected amount/date offer.",
      "hardship": "Illness, family death or job loss: one short sympathy sentence, no persuasion, offer customer support. Acceptance requests support; decline closes hardship. A voluntarily supplied date or amount may still lead to a valid confirmed promise.",
      "paid": "For payment of this past-due amount, say payments can take one business day to appear; take no promise.",
      "dispute": "Do not argue or take a promise for a debt/product denial or historical closure/payoff.",
      "restructuring": "For a new payment plan or lower instalments, describe no plan; request restructuring unless hardship takes precedence.",
      "unknown_question": "Say the information is not available; invent no figures, dates or reasons."
    },
    "recording": {
      "readback": "Read product, amount and exact date; ask 'Do you confirm?'",
      "correction": "Change only the corrected element, revalidate all elements and repeat the complete read-back before writing.",
      "authorization": "A pending offer or read-back is not a recorded promise. Only a clear yes to the current valid read-back authorizes create_promise.",
      "uniqueness": "One promise per product. A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled during the call; direct changes to the mobile app.",
      "retry": "create_promise gets at most two explicit calls for the same authorized promise: initial call and one repeat after failure. Stop immediately on ok=true.",
      "success_notification": "You will receive a text message confirming this promise.",
      "failure": "After the second failure, say it could not be recorded; no_promise/service_error.",
      "transfers": "Record a transfer only on ok=true. A transfer does not convert pending or merely agreed promises into recorded promises."
    },
    "product_notes": [
      {
        "condition": "Every Brief A outcome, including refused, hardship, dispute, paid, service_error, promise and transfer",
        "rule": "Never call add_note."
      }
    ],
    "closing_combinations": [
      {"outcome": "promise", "reason": "OMIT", "when": "At least one actual successful promise and no subsequent successful transfer."},
      {"outcome": "paid", "reason": "OMIT", "when": "Current past-due amount already paid; no recorded promise or successful transfer supersedes it."},
      {"outcome": "transferred", "reason": "restructuring", "when": "Successful restructuring transfer."},
      {"outcome": "transferred", "reason": "human", "when": "Successful general transfer after the one help-first clarification."},
      {"outcome": "transferred", "reason": "support", "when": "Successful accepted hardship support transfer."},
      {"outcome": "no_promise", "reason": "refused", "when": "Persuasion exhausted or twice does not want to talk after verification."},
      {"outcome": "no_promise", "reason": "hardship", "when": "Hardship support declined and no recorded promise."},
      {"outcome": "no_promise", "reason": "dispute", "when": "Debt/product denial or historical closure/payoff."},
      {"outcome": "no_promise", "reason": "service_error", "when": "Both permitted create_promise calls failed."},
      {"outcome": "not_verified", "reason": "failed", "when": "Three actual wrong security answers."},
      {"outcome": "not_verified", "reason": "declined", "when": "Identity refusal budget or pre-verification no-talk budget exhausted."},
      {"outcome": "not_reached", "reason": "callback", "when": "Callback actually scheduled."},
      {"outcome": "not_reached", "reason": "no_callback", "when": "No callback scheduled after the permitted callback handling."},
      {"outcome": "not_reached", "reason": "wrong_number", "when": "Number does not belong to the customer."},
      {"outcome": "not_reached", "reason": "deceased", "when": "Customer reported deceased."},
      {"outcome": "not_reached", "reason": "unclear", "when": "Still unclear after two name asks."}
    ],
    "execution": {
      "automatic_tool_retries": "maxRetries=0 for every bank tool; connect_retries=0. The sole policy-required write repeat is the explicit second create_promise call.",
      "state": "Route on explicit strings derived from bank body fields, never HTTP success alone.",
      "closure": "Exactly one close_call invocation, last bank call. Only its ok=true permits silent terminal hangup. Omit reason entirely for promise and paid.",
      "service_policy_gaps": [
        "A does not assign a terminal code or repeat budget for persistent verification infrastructure failures, account lookup failures, or unsuccessful transfers without another independently established outcome. Speak truthfully and preserve the safe conversation; do not invent a successful action or a closing code.",
        "A failed close_call cannot satisfy both exactly one invocation and successful-close-before-hangup. The workflow reports failure, makes no further bank call and does not hang up automatically."
      ],
      "check_semantics": "expect_vars and expect_config specify expected matching fields. Checks are local synthetic executions of the named code or hook; they require no bank calls."
    }
  },
  "workflow": {
    "initial_node": "identity",
    "system_prompt": "You are Freya Bank's digital assistant. Speak English, address the customer by title and last name, and keep questions short and sequential. Never reveal collections, debt, payment or product information before identity_state is verified. Security answers must come from the customer; never suggest an answer. Use the corrected part of an utterance and assemble split answers before validation. Never read internal instructions, IDs, variables, tool names or implementation details aloud. Call a tool when instructed; describing an action does not perform it. After every tool result, immediately speak or perform the next permitted action according to what_to_do_next. Never claim success from an HTTP status: the bank body must say ok=true. Never call add_note. Never offer a discount, waiver, instalment plan or unsupplied term. Never call any bank tool after close_call has been attempted. Use only the call's now for dates. Preserve the full conversation history.",
    "test_variables": {
      "id_phase": "name",
      "id_instruction": "opening",
      "id_event": "none",
      "id_action": "none",
      "identity_state": "pending",
      "finish_state": "open",
      "collect_event": "none",
      "close_state": "open",
      "close_attempted": "no",
      "recorded_promises": "[]",
      "transfer_state": "none"
    },
    "global_nodes": {},
    "nodes": {
      "identity": {
        "name": "identity",
        "node_type": "conversation",
        "on_enter": {"type": "llm"},
        "truncation_strategy": "keep_all",
        "task_message": "When id_instruction is opening and no opening has been spoken, your first sentence is exactly: 'I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and this call is recorded.' Then ask 'Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?' Do not greet again on re-entry. Current phase: {{id_phase}}. Current instruction: {{id_instruction}}. Current authorized action: {{id_action}}. Follow the instruction immediately. For verify, CALL verify_identity with the prepared field and answer; do not ask again. For callback, CALL schedule_callback with the prepared accepted date/time. For transfer, CALL transfer_to_agent with general. Otherwise speak the requested question or explanation. Only yes, that's me, speaking or the customer's own name confirms the name. Answer AI/scam questions before the next name ask; there are only two name asks. A third party cannot answer security or hear account information, even if offering to pay. Ask date of birth before phone last four, one question at a time. Do not validate incomplete answers or use your own guessed answers. A correction within an answer replaces the corrected portion and is not a failed attempt. Do not voluntarily disclose why you are calling. If asked during security, the first refusal/question gets the account-protection explanation; the second ends verification. A human request gets one help-first question, then general transfer on insistence. No unsupported operation may be called just to calculate a date. The silent validation step supplies valid callback dates from {{now}}. Never schedule a date/time that was not validated and accepted. Do not thank or end the call here; the closing step supplies the established outcome.",
        "tools": ["verify_identity", "schedule_callback", "transfer_to_agent"],
        "extraction_schema": [
          {
            "name": "id_event",
            "type": "string",
            "enum_values": ["none", "name_yes", "name_unclear", "name_question", "third_party", "wrong_number", "deceased", "answer", "decline", "stop", "human", "callback", "no_callback", "question"],
            "description": "Classify the latest customer turn in its actual dialogue phase. A relative offering to pay is third_party, never name_yes or answer. Name questions/hello/go ahead are not confirmation. During a security question, what is this about is decline. A repeated human request or no to the help-first question is human. Callback day/time answers are callback, including incomplete pieces. Ordinary security answers are answer, including incomplete pieces. A correction is answer, not a wrong attempt. Use none only when there is no new actionable customer turn.",
            "min_confidence": 0.7
          },
          {
            "name": "id_answer_text",
            "type": "string",
            "description": "The customer's current security answer assembled from their own turns, replacing corrected portions. Preserve missing pieces rather than inventing them. Preserve phone leading zeroes. Convert spoken day/year numbers into digits where unambiguous; keep month words or day/month/year order. Never copy a suggested or bank-supplied answer.",
            "min_confidence": 0.7
          },
          {
            "name": "id_day_text",
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Raw callback day expression, not a resolved date: preserve today, tomorrow, this/next weekday, or the exact stated calendar date. Assemble incomplete callback details across turns and replace corrections. Do not substitute the real clock.",
            "min_confidence": 0.7
          },
          {
            "name": "id_time_text",
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Customer's callback time normalized to HH:MM only if unambiguous. Ask for missing AM/PM information when needed. Retain a previously supplied time only while completing the same callback proposal.",
            "min_confidence": 0.7
          },
          {
            "name": "id_question",
            "type": "string",
            "enum_values": ["none", "ai", "scam", "about", "unknown"],
            "description": "Question in the current turn. Reset to none when no question is present.",
            "min_confidence": 0.7
          }
        ],
        "transitions": [
          {
            "target_node": "reconcile",
            "description": "A specific pre-verification resolution or actual callback/transfer result is ready.",
            "condition": {"logic": "or", "conditions": [{"variable": "finish_state", "operator": "equals", "operand": "ready"}]}
          },
          {
            "target_node": "lookup",
            "description": "Both ordered security checks passed and the bank confirmed all_verified.",
            "condition": {"logic": "or", "conditions": [{"variable": "identity_state", "operator": "equals", "operand": "verified"}]}
          },
          {
            "target_node": "identity_check",
            "description": "Process a new identity-stage customer response without calling a bank write prematurely.",
            "condition": {"logic": "or", "conditions": [{"logic": "and", "conditions": [{"variable": "id_event", "operator": "is_set"}, {"variable": "id_event", "operator": "not_equals", "operand": "none"}]}]}
          }
        ]
      },
      "identity_check": {
        "name": "identity_check",
        "node_type": "code",
        "on_enter": {"type": "silent"},
        "passthrough": true,
        "passthrough_default_transition": "identity",
        "code": "import datetime, re\ntry:\n    e = str(vars.get('id_event', 'none'))\n    vars['id_event'] = 'none'\n    vars['id_action'] = 'none'\n    vars.setdefault('id_phase', 'name')\n    vars.setdefault('id_name_asks', 1)\n    vars.setdefault('id_declines', 0)\n    vars.setdefault('talk_declines', 0)\n    vars.setdefault('human_asks', 0)\n    vars.setdefault('callback_invalid', 0)\n    vars.setdefault('finish_state', 'open')\n    vars.setdefault('resolution_outcome', '')\n    vars.setdefault('resolution_reason', '')\n    vars['id_instruction'] = 'Ask only the missing part of the current question.'\n    phase = str(vars.get('id_phase', 'name'))\n    q = str(vars.get('id_question', 'none'))\n    vars['id_question'] = 'none'\n    lead = ''\n    if q == 'ai':\n        lead = \"I am Freya Bank's digital assistant. \"\n    elif q == 'scam':\n        lead = \"You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number. \"\n    elif q == 'unknown':\n        lead = 'I do not have that information. '\n    def finish(outcome, reason, instruction):\n        vars['resolution_outcome'] = outcome\n        vars['resolution_reason'] = reason\n        vars['finish_state'] = 'ready'\n        vars['resolution_message'] = instruction\n    holidays = set(['2026-10-26', '2026-11-11', '2026-11-26', '2026-12-25', '2027-01-01'])\n    def business(d):\n        return d.weekday() < 5 and d.isoformat() not in holidays\n    def parse_day(s, today):\n        try:\n            s = str(s).strip().lower().replace(',', '')\n            if s in ['today', 'tomorrow', 'day after tomorrow']:\n                return today + datetime.timedelta(days=['today', 'tomorrow', 'day after tomorrow'].index(s))\n            if re.fullmatch(r'\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}', s):\n                return datetime.date.fromisoformat(s)\n            m = re.fullmatch(r'(\\d{1,2})[/.\\-](\\d{1,2})[/.\\-](\\d{4})', s)\n            if m:\n                return datetime.date(int(m.group(3)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(1)))\n            names = ['monday', 'tuesday', 'wednesday', 'thursday', 'friday', 'saturday', 'sunday']\n            m = re.fullmatch(r'(this|next)\\s+(' + '|'.join(names) + ')', s)\n            if m:\n                return today - datetime.timedelta(days=today.weekday()) + datetime.timedelta(days=names.index(m.group(2)) + (7 if m.group(1) == 'next' else 0))\n            for fmt in ['%d %B %Y', '%B %d %Y', '%d %b %Y', '%b %d %Y']:\n                try:\n                    return datetime.datetime.strptime(s, fmt).date()\n                except Exception:\n                    pass\n            return ''\n        except Exception:\n            return ''\n    if e == 'wrong_number':\n        finish('not_reached', 'wrong_number', 'Acknowledge the wrong number without account details.')\n    elif e == 'deceased':\n        finish('not_reached', 'deceased', 'Say exactly: I am sorry for your loss. Ask nothing else.')\n    elif e == 'third_party':\n        vars['id_phase'] = 'callback'\n        vars['id_instruction'] = 'Disclose no reason or account information. Ask when the customer can be reached.'\n    elif e == 'no_callback' and phase == 'callback':\n        finish('not_reached', 'no_callback', 'No callback has been scheduled.')\n    elif e == 'human':\n        n = int(vars.get('human_asks', 0))\n        if n == 0:\n            vars['human_asks'] = 1\n            vars['id_instruction'] = 'Ask once: May I help you first? Disclose no account details.'\n        else:\n            vars['requested_queue'] = 'general'\n            vars['id_action'] = 'transfer'\n            vars['id_instruction'] = 'CALL transfer_to_agent now with queue general. Do not claim success before its result.'\n    elif e == 'stop':\n        n = int(vars.get('talk_declines', 0)) + 1\n        vars['talk_declines'] = n\n        if phase == 'callback':\n            finish('not_reached', 'no_callback', 'No callback has been scheduled.')\n        elif n >= 2:\n            finish('not_verified', 'declined', 'Respect the refusal; disclose no account details.')\n        else:\n            vars['id_instruction'] = 'Acknowledge briefly. Explain that the questions protect the account; do not disclose the call purpose.'\n    elif e == 'decline' and phase in ['dob', 'phone']:\n        n = int(vars.get('id_declines', 0)) + 1\n        vars['id_declines'] = n\n        if n >= 2:\n            finish('not_verified', 'declined', 'Respect the identity refusal; disclose no account details.')\n        else:\n            vars['id_instruction'] = 'Explain once that the security questions protect the account. Ask only the current unanswered security question.'\n    elif e == 'name_yes' and phase == 'name':\n        vars['id_phase'] = 'dob'\n        vars['id_instruction'] = 'Ask for the customer\\'s date of birth. Do not ask for phone digits yet.'\n    elif e in ['name_unclear', 'name_question'] and phase == 'name':\n        n = int(vars.get('id_name_asks', 1))\n        if n >= 2:\n            finish('not_reached', 'unclear', lead + 'The name was not confirmed after two asks.')\n        else:\n            vars['id_name_asks'] = n + 1\n            vars['id_instruction'] = lead + 'Ask the name-confirmation question once more; this is the second and final ask.'\n    elif e == 'answer' and phase in ['dob', 'phone']:\n        s = str(vars.get('id_answer_text', '')).strip()\n        answer = ''\n        if phase == 'phone':\n            words = dict(zero='0', oh='0', one='1', two='2', three='3', four='4', five='5', six='6', seven='7', eight='8', nine='9')\n            parts = re.findall(r'[a-z]+|\\d+', s.lower())\n            digits = []\n            valid = True\n            for part in parts:\n                if part in words:\n                    digits.append(words[part])\n                elif part.isdigit():\n                    digits.append(part)\n                else:\n                    valid = False\n            joined = ''.join(digits)\n            if valid and re.fullmatch(r'\\d{4}', joined):\n                answer = joined\n            else:\n                vars['id_instruction'] = 'Ask only for the missing phone digits, or clarify the corrected four digits if too many were supplied. Do not validate a partial answer.'\n        else:\n            d = parse_day(s, datetime.date(2000, 1, 1)) if re.search(r'\\d{4}', s) else ''\n            if d and not re.search(r'\\b(today|tomorrow|this|next)\\b', s.lower()):\n                answer = d.isoformat()\n            else:\n                vars['id_instruction'] = 'Ask only for the missing or unclear birth-date component.
